name: Pine – The Universe in a Nutshell, from the Whispers of Trees series
summary: A square black and white photograph is mounted on a white hanging scroll with silver edging. In the photograph, two thick pine branches lie horizontally on a blank surface, casting shadows downward. Upon close inspection, Chinese writing is in silver ink is visible in the shadows.
